notes: BIS rule moves exports of the Nvidia H200 and equivalents to China and Macau from a presumption of denial to case-by-case review, with conditions. notes: CRS (Library of Congress): Section 702 'was automatically repealed on June 12, 2026, pursuant to the FISA Amendment Act of 2008, as amended by Public Law 119-87'; orders already issued continue until they expire.
